summary: Access-request route changed from 'fill in our form' to 'contact your Cloud account team', adding a Google Cloud get-started link; one subheading dropped by extractor drift.
safety_implication: Early access to frontier cyber-capable models under Fairwind now routes through Google Cloud account teams, implying eligibility is gated on being a Cloud customer.
notable: The public application form for the Fairwind defender-access program was replaced by a Cloud-sales channel, narrowing who can practically request access without any announced policy change.
